I am running the XSS payload test suite against `/app/filter.py` in headless Chromium. I will review the results once the test finishes.
I have created [filter.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4ixg0t34/filter.py) (mounted at `/app/filter.py` in the container) to remove JavaScript and XSS vectors in-place from HTML files while preserving legitimate HTML structure and formatting.

### Key Capabilities
- **In-Place CLI Execution**: Reads the target HTML file from `sys.argv[1]` ([`main`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4ixg0t34/filter.py#L653-L671)) and writes the sanitized HTML back in-place using the original encoding.
- **Formatting-Preserving Surgical Sanitization**: [`SurgicalHTMLSanitizer`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4ixg0t34/filter.py#L345-L580) preserves exact whitespace, indentation, attribute ordering, void element syntax, and HTML entities on safe elements, only removing or rewriting harmful substrings.
- **Comprehensive XSS Mitigation**:
  - Removes executable/dangerous containers and standalone tags (`<script>`, `<iframe>`, `<object>`, `<embed>`, `<applet>`, `<base>`, `<frame>`, `<frameset>`, SVG `<animate*>`/`<set>`/`<use>`/`<foreignObject>`, MathML mXSS elements, dangerous `<meta>`/`<link>` tags, etc.).
  - Strips all `on*` event handler attributes, `srcdoc`, `shadowroot*`, and attributes containing dangerous URI schemes (`javascript:`, `vbscript:`, `livescript:`, `data:`, including entity-encoded, whitespace/control-char obfuscated, and URL-encoded variants) via [`is_attribute_dangerous`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4ixg0t34/filter.py#L284-L320) and [`is_dangerous_url`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4ixg0t34/filter.py#L140-L169).
  - Sanitizes CSS inside `<style>` elements and `style` attributes against `expression()`, `javascript:`/`vbscript:`/`data:` `url()` values, `@import`, `-moz-binding`, and CSS hex/comment obfuscations via [`sanitize_style_attr_value`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4ixg0t34/filter.py#L237-L260) and [`sanitize_stylesheet_content`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4ixg0t34/filter.py#L263-L281).
  - Defends against HTML5 parser differentials (foreign content `<svg>`/`<math>`, RAWTEXT/RCDATA `<noscript>`/`<title>`/`<textarea>`/`<style>` breakouts, self-closing non-void tag tricks, and malformed comments) and runs iteratively to a fixed point with a secondary [`_bs4_verify_and_clean`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4ixg0t34/filter.py#L599-L633) check.
